description.tr: Yemenli şair, doğum ve vefatı Zebîd'de olmuştur. Suleyhîler nezdinde inşâ reisi idi.
description.en: Yemenite poet, his birth and death were in Zabīd. He was chief of composition under the Sulayhids.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: al-Ḥusayn b. ʿAlī b. Muḥammad b. Maymūyah, Abū ʿAbd Allāh, known as Ibn al-Qumm

tr: el-Hüseyin b. Ali b. Muhammed b. Memûyeh, Ebû Abdullâh, el-maʿrûf b-İbn el-Kum
ar: الحسين بن علي بن محمد بن ممويه، أبو عبد الله، المعروف ب ابن القم
